lines.en: Vasilka stands at the gate,

lines.cyr: Јонче ми врви крај порти џанам,

lines.en: Jonche walks by the gate, my dear,
Jonche walks by the gate.
- Vasilka, white lady,

your mother, Vaska, and your father.
Vaska, hey fair girl,
Vaska, I am dying for you,
Vaska, hey fair girl,
Vaska, I am burning up for you.
Go and ask your mother,

your mother, Vaska, and your father.

to me, Jonche the carouser, my dear,
to me, Jonche the carouser.
Vaska, hey fair girl,
Vaska, I am dying for you,
Vaska, hey fair girl,
Vaska, I am burning up for you.

a carouser and a drunkard.
Jonche, hey fair lad,

Jonche, hey fair lad,
Jonche, I am burning up for you.

lines.en: do not listen to your mother, my dear,

lines.en: come on, let the two of us marry, my dear,
come on, let the two of us marry.
